description: List uploaded media files with optional search and pagination. Returns file metadata including URLs, dimensions, and labels. Use this when the user wants a list of their uploaded media files.

type.description: Filter by media kind: image, video or document (PDF, Word and PowerPoint files). Omit for all files. The response's `total` counts matches across all pages.

name: list_media

files.description: Media files on this page. id is what mediaFileIds takes.

total.description: Files matching the filters, across every page.

title: List media
